items.title: 52240_Frank _Machito_ Grillo oral history interview
items.q: Pepe Beque and Cachao was hired to dance up there.

ctx.x: Uh - huh, and how many other times did Chano go to the Conga?
Well, as a matter of fact, Pepe Beque and Cachao was hired to dance up there. They used to go practically every night.
Well, they were hired, but not him?
